kinds.description: A carried v1 record of any type/kind with no first-class v2 definition (everything except Document:note). The v1 type and kind are preserved verbatim in v1_type/v1_kind; title, summary and lifecycle carry the v1 short prose and state. The record body is not a field: bodies live in the kernel body lane.

fields.name: v1_type
fields.description: The v1 record type, preserved verbatim.

fields.name: v1_kind
fields.description: The v1 record kind, preserved verbatim.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Short human title. May be absent: importers omit empty v1 names and no title is invented.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: Short v1 summary, when the v1 record carries one.

fields.name: lifecycle
fields.description: Free-text v1 lifecycle state (open, in_progress, blocked, done, cancelled, ...). No enumeration is enforced: the v1 vocabulary is open.
